remarks: Discover the charm and ease of condominium living with this inviting first floor home at 22 Hale Lane, nestled in the desirable Middlesex Commons complex. This delightful residence boasts a thoughtful layout, offering 900 square feet of comfortable living space designed to suit your lifestyle.  Step inside to find a bright and airy one-bedroom retreat. The open floor plan seamlessly connects the spacious living room with wood burning fireplace and lovely dining area with built in bench, providing an ideal setting for both relaxing and entertaining. Large windows bathe the interior in natural light, enhancing the home's warm and inviting atmosphere. The kitchen is well-appointed, featuring updated white cabinetry and modern appliances, perfect for culinary endeavors.  The bedroom is generously sized, providing a tranquil escape with ample closet space. The primary bathroom is tastefully designed with a large double sink vanity and a new spacious shower, offering both functionality and style. Laundry is easy access off the primary bath.  Beyond the interior, Middlesex Commons offers beautiful landscaping and well-maintained common areas, ensuring a pleasant community environment. Its convenient location in Darien means you're just moments away from local shops, dining, and recreational opportunities, making it an ideal choice for those seeking both comfort and convenience.  Don't miss the chance to make this charming condo your own sanctuary.
